movies.description_full: After the 9/11 attacks, no one could agree what should be done with Ground Zero. And so New York did something really crazy. They asked the people to decide.

movies.title: Mizu de kakareta monogatari
movies.description_full: A young man who's about to marry is torn between his fiancée and the love for his mother. His past, dreams and desires unfold simultaneously.

movies.title: Mama I Want to Sing
movies.description_full: A preacher's daughter, Amara, sings in the church choir before being discovered by a well-established musician. Soon she rises to international fame as a pop singer.

movies.title: Sarah Millican: Chatterbox Live
movies.description_full: Recorded in London earlier this year, Chatterbox Live invites you to enter the wonderful world of Sarah Millican--where living alone drives your parents to put you on suicide watch; where a cup of tea in the bath is the epitome of luxury and where free family planning clinic condoms make perfect stocking fillers.

movies.title: I'm About to Lose Control and I Think Joe Lycett
movies.description_full: Joe Lycett's brand new stand up show is ready for you to stream and/or download. You will totally love it Babe!

movies.title: The Spin
movies.description_full: Two music-loving but unlikely friends have two days to travel the length of Ireland to save their record store from closure. For one of them, not having a car is just one of the problems.

movies.title: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
movies.description_full: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story.

movies.title: Billy: The Early Years
movies.description_full: Everyone knows who he is. Now find out how he got there. The early life of American Evangelist Billy Graham.

movies.title: Jet
movies.description_full: A cowboy fighter pilot and his mercenary wingman take on deadly off-the-books missions for the highest bidder, until their latest job pits them against a powerful artificial intelligence that could change the future of warfare forever.

movies.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
movies.description_full: When Ali G discovers that his long-term girlfriend is 8 months pregnant, he ends his 20 year nap and heads to America to reclaim his former glory and earn some "cashmoney". This turns out to be far from the formality he expected.

movies.title: Terrestrial
movies.description_full: Dave is a teacher forced to work in an environment where he feels as though he doesn't belong. Maybe the discovery of a seemingly dead alien in a lava tube is the one thing that can get him out of his pathetic rut and back into the game?

movies.title: Nikola Tesla 19hz
movies.description_full: Nikola Tesla-visionary, inventor, genius. The world remembers his groundbreaking discoveries, but few know the secret that consumed his final years: a relentless quest to reach the other side.

movies.title: 2: Voodoo Academy
movies.description_full: Young hot travelers are sidelined by a road blocked with fallen trees, and stop for a night at the mansion belonging to sexy Sebastian. The house has a history of voodoo, mayhem and horror, and new arrivals are fresh meat for the hungry house...

movies.title: The Pleasure Garden
movies.description_full: Two couples' romances are fancifully intertwined.

movies.title: The Doll People Tapes
movies.description_full: Recovered footage reveals the lives of sex workers in a small town as they share their struggles and hopes. As filming continues, unsettling events unfold, leaving behind disturbing evidence of what may have happened to them.

movies.title: Nebâ afutâ dâku
movies.description_full: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

movies.title: Dirty South House Arrest
movies.description_full: LOGLINE: A college kid is sentenced to house arrest after committing a crime to impress a girl. After jail and possibly losing the family home, he decides to throw a house party to raise money for his mom while she is away.

movies.title: Company of Shadows
movies.description_full: In order to facilitate a business deal, a gay and a straight couple, share traumatic events to instill trust in each other. When ulterior motives come to the surface, dark secrets are revealed that result in serious conflict.

movies.title: Ever After
movies.description_full: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

movies.title: Swamp Dogg Gets His Pool Painted
movies.description_full: Cult musician Swamp Dogg and housemates Moogstar and Guitar Shorty have turned their suburban LA home into an artistic haven. They journey through the turbulent music business, forming a special friendship transcending eras.

movies.title: Due West
movies.description_full: A small-town woman in need of medical care in West Texas is forced to break the law.

movies.title: Concessions
movies.description_full: On the last day at the closing Royal Alamo Cinema, employees, outcasts and oddballs cross paths in interwoven stories of rejection, redemption, and fate.

movies.title: Mum, I'm Alien Pregnant
movies.description_full: When a messy millennial underachiever accidentally gets alien-pregnant she must overcome sceptical doctors, a useless baby-daddy, and her oversharing mum in order to survive and reclaim her life.

movies.title: Forgotten Island
movies.description_full: Two best friends become stranded on the mystical world of Nakali, where their only escape might cost them their shared lifetime of memories.

movies.title: Verity
movies.description_full: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

movies.title: The Lost Ones
movies.description_full: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

movies.title: The Stunt Driver
movies.description_full: The film chronicles the daredevil stuntman Ken Carter's quest to execute a bold stunt of launching a rocket car across the St. Lawrence River from Canada to the United States in the 1970s, facing absurd challenges along the way.

movies.title: Sense and Sensibility
movies.description_full: Sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must leave their Sussex estate to live with a distant relative, while facing both romantic and financial struggles.

movies.title: Reptilians: They Walk Among Us
movies.description_full: They wear our faces, shape our destiny, and have waited through the ages for the perfect moment to rise, igniting a spiritual battle for our future.

movies.title: Maya & Samar
movies.description_full: Set in contemporary Athens, Maya and Samar tells the story of two young women from conflicting cultures whose brief yet torrid affair endangers the life of one, while propelling the other to instant online fame.

movies.title: The Dog Stars
movies.description_full: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

movies.title: Horrorcane
movies.description_full: A couple rents a south Florida estate with an antique mirror that opens to other dimensions, including a demon realm with no escape. Vengeful contractors, supernatural beings, and a psychotic realtor add chaos as a mega storm approaches.

movies.title: A Hard Place
movies.description_full: After a failed heist, a group of fugitives hide in a remote winter forest-only to discover two monstrous factions locked in a savage blood feud. Trapped between them, humans quickly become prey.

movies.title: Lycaon
movies.description_full: As savage animal attacks spread panic through New Falls, psychologists Jeff Matthews and Nick Toscani investigate a chilling mystery that points to a supernatural force, ancient legend, and a dark terror stalking the woods.

movies.title: The Devil Dared Me To
movies.description_full: Young Randy has dreamed of being a stuntman, teaming up with misfit stunt-team the Timaru Hellriders, is employed by mentor-turned Dick Johansonson, and meets the one-legged cunning stunt babe Tracy "Tragedy" Jones.

movies.title: Call Her Savage
movies.description_full: Sexy Texas gal storms her way through life, brawling and boozing until her luck runs out, forcing her to learn the errors of her ways.

movies.title: The Guard Room
movies.description_full: Hilda gets a job as an overnight security guard at a rundown warehouse district. She soon discovers that a security officer mysteriously died in the parking lot, and starts to unravel the clues while surviving the shifts.

movies.title: Showdown in Secret City
movies.description_full: Four filmmakers are forced to comply with a movie executive's demands to create a blockbuster with the help of artificial intelligence or else.

movies.title: Cool Breeze
movies.description_full: Thalmus is the leader for a group of criminals who gather in L.A. to rob a bank. Their goal is to find a new bank.

movies.title: Class of '74
movies.description_full: Four young modern women in college set out to explore all that life has to give with various new relationships and to study the ones they have been exposed to in their past.

movies.title: 17 Days
movies.description_full: 17 Days is a powerful, riveting, film about 23 year old Brianna Murphy, and Damien Williams. A relationship that started out as a fairytale, ends up a nightmare. 17 Days touches your heart, rocks your soul to the core.

In the pre-Spanish era Philippines, a young beautiful native princess falls in love with a handsome Spanish soldier. Against all odds, and pulled apart by their loyalties to their own people, they fight for their clandestine romance.

movies.title: 3 Mile Limit
movies.description_full: It's 1965 and rock music is shaking up the world but not in New Zealand. A 23-year-old journalist is determined to break the government's monopoly on broadcasting.

movies.title: Geo-Storm
movies.description_full: Earth's gravity weakens, causing devastating earthquakes and electric anomalies that magnetize objects to catastrophic effect. As the planet is ripped apart, a team of expert scientists must figure out the cause and save the world.

movies.title: Man Across the Street
movies.description_full: A chilling psychological thriller where a woman fleeing an abusive past moves across the street from a master manipulator. Blending domestic suspense with a "house of horrors" twist.

movies.title: 13 Slays Till X-Mas
movies.description_full: On December 24th, five seemingly random men are invited to a dive bar by a mysterious e-mail. They decide to pass the time by resurrecting the old tradition of telling scary stories on Christmas Eve.

movies.title: ID2: Shadwell Army
movies.description_full: A young British Asian, Mo is a fast-rising police officer who goes under cover infiltrating Shadwell's resurgent hooligan element, who are fired up by Shadwells's takeover by a Russian oligarch and their unlikely adventure into European competition. Mo quickly becomes embroiled in the local schism between the BNP and EDL and plans to build a new mosque in the shadow of the Shadwell ground creates an explosive environment in which football and political violence form a perfect storm of social unrest. In the midst of this, Mo is faced with the essential existential question of of who he really is and where he really belongs. It's 20 years on and clever Trevor is now chief super, but what happens to the rest of the gang?

movies.title: ZombieSluts Stripclub Slaughterhouse
movies.description_full: A zombie outbreak happens at local strip club. Patrons and dancers attempt to survive.

movies.title: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt
movies.description_full: Follows the story of the Butthole Surfers - the groundbreaking and influential art-punk band founded in early-Eighties Texas by frontman Gibby Haynes and guitarist Paul Leary.

movies.title: Camp Blood Christmas
movies.description_full: The infamous Camp Blackwood has a new owner intent on leaving its murderous history behind by turning it into a Christmas attraction for families. As new employees start showing up, they learn the killer clown of Camp Blood may not be ready to be forgotten.

movies.title: A Possession in Lincoln County
movies.description_full: A man documents his wife's cancer-until a terminal diagnosis leads him to an ancient ritual to summon the Devil and make a deal. His footage spirals into a chilling record of kidnapping, demonic rituals, and the price of desperation.

movies.title: Written in Blood
movies.description_full: When Selena's family is wrongfully executed by the Mexican Cartel, she wages a violent war against their leader, Lucas Almonte. She forms an unexpected alliance with Nuevo Laredo Police Detective Alex, who has her own demons to face.

movies.title: Alien in the Heartland
movies.description_full: Amidst growing fears of an alien invasion with shapeshifting capabilities, a paranoid widower imprisons two sisters seeking refuge, convinced one is an extraterrestrial.

movies.title: Cassex
movies.description_full: When a married couple digs up a dirty home movie, it not only spices up their love life but transports them to an erotic dimension haunted by an eighties sex icon. Is it real, or is it Cassex?

movies.title: Everton, Howard's Way
movies.description_full: The story of Everton at the peak of their powers in the mid-1980s, when they became the best side in the land.

movies.title: The American Miracle
movies.description_full: "The American Miracle" is a journey through some of the most significant events in America's rise to power, reliving the improbabilities that demonstrate what the Founders always believed: that events unfolded according to a master plan.

movies.title: Young and Cursed
movies.description_full: Five youths in a remote area are trapped under the spell of a woman possessed by Lilith, an ancient biblical demon. Unable to break free, they face their destiny as time runs out.

movies.title: Rubber Nose Massacre
movies.description_full: Two Florida Man vigilantes hunt for a psychopathic serial killing clown.

movies.title: The Cowboy Killer
movies.description_full: When a delusional killer in a cowboy costume starts treating a small town like his personal shooting range, two bumbling detectives must track him down and free his captive bride before he kills again.

movies.title: Peaky Blinders: The Real Story
movies.description_full: A behind-the-scenes documentary uncovering the real history of Birmingham's Peaky Blinders, separating fact from fiction in the hit TV series and exploring the creative vision behind its unique style.

movies.title: Final Orbit
movies.description_full: Across a dying Earth and the far reaches of space, humanity faces its final tests. Stranded astronauts, desperate survivors, conflicted pilots and an isolated diplomat must decide what is worth saving before time runs out.

movies.title: Fettered
movies.description_full: In the gripping thriller Fettered, sixteen-year-old Paris from the Bronx wakes up completely disoriented in a dense, remote forest, chained to a tree and bleeding heavily from a gunshot wound. With no memory of how she got there or who attacked her, she is thrust into a desperate fight for survival against both her severe injuries and the unforgiving elements. To unlock the key to her escape and unmask her kidnapper, Paris must mentally piece together the hazy, fragmented memories of her final day at school before time runs out. Meanwhile, a frantic race against the clock unfolds back home as Paris's family and friends launch a high-stakes search to find her. As they exhaust every possible resource to track her location, the tension escalates into a dual battle against nature and a ticking clock. The searchers must piece together their own clues to reach Paris before she succumbs to blood loss—or before the sinister force lurking in the shadows of the woods finds her first.

movies.title: Rescued
movies.description_full: A homeless man finds the motivation to turn his life around after gaining the companionship of a stray dog.

movies.title: World War Bigfoot
movies.description_full: When his platoon is ambushed during WWII, an American medic must evade the enemy in the nearby forest, unaware that something else lurks there.

movies.title: The Girl We Let In
movies.description_full: Following the adoption of 16-year-old Sophie, Hope begins to suspect her new daughter is hiding a terrible secret that will endanger her family.

movies.title: Weevil
movies.description_full: Black Mountain National Park has long harbored a strange history, from masses of missing livestock that have wandered onto the mountain to unusual disappearances and reappearances of local townspeople. One such case involved members of the entire Wahldrov family, who were never found. Cassian Wahldrov returns home, to the town of Black Mountain, following the disappearance of his autistic younger brother Manny. Together, he and his sister Mae set out to find their lost brother. Their efforts are quickly overshadowed by a strange force that both splits them up and slowly picks them apart.

movies.title: Junk
movies.description_full: It's nighttime in LA: a pill-addled screenwriter struggles with writer's block; across town, two young drifters with a lost dog search for their stolen car.

movies.title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
movies.description_full: Comedian Maria Bamford weaves her mental health experiences into hilarious, uplifting comedy, showing how she channels personal vulnerability into artistic power through raw authenticity.

movies.title: The Cycle
movies.description_full: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

movies.title: Sakamoto Deizu
movies.description_full: After getting married and having a daughter, a retired legendary hitman must protect his family when his past catches up to him.

movies.title: Human
movies.description_full: Follows Dani Ferris, alone and exhausted, who seeks a moment of digital distraction before bed but instead gets thrust into a blood-drenched supernatural nightmare filled with horrors and heartbreak.

movies.title: The Exit State
movies.description_full: In the not-too-distant future, a group of American citizens attempt to flee the country to escape an authoritarian regime, but their path to freedom quickly becomes a dystopian nightmare.

movies.title: Love Language
movies.description_full: A social media writer starts a wedding vow business, but her world turns upside down when her latest client is engaged to her college crush.

movies.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
movies.description_full: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

movies.title: Buried Alive
movies.description_full: Officer Briggs chases criminals into an abandoned missile facility, where they're trapped by a mysterious Overseer who forces them through deadly trials while mutants hunt them in the depths below.

movies.title: 12 Months
movies.description_full: Ellie and Clark, a new couple, experience their first year together, navigating the highs and lows of a new relationship.

movies.title: Broker 2
movies.description_full: Broker 2 follows a serial killer who, looking for a challenge, moves to the city, where the realities and responsibilities of daily living prove too much for someone used to answering to nothing but his own whims.

movies.title: Bloodsuckers and the Grimoire
movies.description_full: Oliver, a college senior, inherits a haunted home, unlocking dark witchcraft and vampires via a grimoire, sparking a terrifying battle for his soul.

movies.title: Black Goat
movies.description_full: In the mysterious town of Blackwood Falls, a young environmental engineer investigates a plague affecting local livestock. He uncovers horrifying secrets tied to cult sacrifices and a demonic entity, known as The Black Goat of the Woods.

movies.title: Betty's Revenge
movies.description_full: College seniors stumble upon Betty, a mysterious former cabaret owner, while exploring an abandoned club. When they uncover her hidden journal, they're forced to flee as she pursues them, intent on making them part of her dark story.

movies.title: Bloody Eyes
movies.description_full: Detectives on a bust find themselves locked in an undercover lab. As they go in deeper they realize there is more to this place than meets the eye, and they're not the only ones that will do whatever it takes to escape.

movies.title: Art of Diversion
movies.description_full: Brother and sister, Daphnis and Chloe Waterspoon are wealthy art collectors who live together in the New York City area. They share an ugly and brutal hobby-they lure unknowing people into sex and then murder them.

movies.title: Blood Totem
movies.description_full: Soldiers venture into Apache county searching for a missing comrade, only to find the land itself has turned hostile. Facing demons both human and mythical in this supernatural western, they must fight to survive.

movies.title: Bloodspawn
movies.description_full: A frontier-era gang of misfits band together to battle an ancient and evil bloodthirsty hellbeast of Native folklore in this retro homage to classic 80's creature features.

movies.title: Beyond the North Woods
movies.description_full: A Logan Paul style YouTuber is guided through a small town's woods to make a video about recent unsolved disappearances. The group questions their sanity as the weather drastically changes and a mind-bending threat stalks them.

movies.title: Are You Dead Yet?
movies.description_full: When a group of thrill seekers venture into supposedly haunted woods, they must fight to survive against a maniac with a mallet and a taste for blood.

movies.title: Axes and Os
movies.description_full: Four college girls on a weekend getaway are hunted by a legendary ax murderer, until the hunter becomes the prey when one female turns out to be something otherworldly.

movies.title: Applewood
movies.description_full: A young widow's latent psychic powers reveal dark secrets inside of a Victorian mansion, forcing her to solve its mysteries before it takes her sanity and her life.

movies.title: Ashes Never Rest
movies.description_full: In a community haunted by domestic strife and inter-community violence, a young Black man finds himself stalked by a sinister Apparition-an embodiment of generational trauma and suppressed identity.

movies.title: All Alone Together
movies.description_full: A tormented filmmaker's life becomes increasingly intertwined with the horrors of his own film.

movies.title: Air Shift
movies.description_full: A small-town radio disk-jockey is taken hostage by a deranged killer during her overnight shift. As the night progresses, a mysterious force outside unleashes zombie-like attackers, who see the radio station as their target.

movies.title: Against All Odds
movies.description_full: Against All Odds, the sequel to Try That Again, follows Jason, Jocelyn, and bartender Lexian as they face the consequences of repeated time manipulation. Hunted by Xaldin, they must outwit fate and survive-against all odds.

movies.title: A44
movies.description_full: A college student is driven to find the source of a mysterious illness that appears to originate in the meat and dairy supply, which has begun to render the local community into mindless killers.

movies.title: 7 Keys
movies.description_full: Daniel has kept the keys to the places he's lived in. Lena wants to use them - on the ultimate tour of London, a weekend of getting to know each other intimately in other people's homes. This risky fantasy soon becomes a deadly threat.

movies.title: Hanarokushô ga Akeru Hi ni
movies.description_full: Keitarô lives inside an abandoned factory once surrounded by lush forest, now redeveloped with solar panels. Before the factory's demolition, he aims to launch his late father's firework with his brother and friend, closing a chapter.

movies.title: The Mephistophiliac
movies.description_full: A man struggling with alcoholism has an even deeper issue to face as he battles his own demons.

movies.title: Grizzly Attack
movies.description_full: A family is trapped in a mountain cabin, hunted by a raging bear with a taste for blood.

movies.title: Popeye: Resurrection
movies.description_full: A fanatical cult resurrects Popeye. He rises furious and uncontrollable, cutting a violent path through anyone who summoned him. One determined survivor must confront the unstoppable sailor and end his rampage once and for all.

movies.title: Baja
movies.description_full: A couple has a big drug deal go bad and flees across the border to Baja California, Mexico. Bebe's dad sends her ex-husband there to talk sense into her. Somebody sends a hit-man there.

movies.title: Relentless
movies.description_full: A homeless man targets a well-off elite in a home invasion. But it will take an unhinged level of brutality to find out his true motive.

movies.title: The Mummy: Reckoning
movies.description_full: In the closing days of the Second World War, the SS attempt to manufacture immortality using stolen Egyptian funerary rites. What they create is not eternal life, but a mummified revenant, a sadistic officer bound into undeath by occult ritual. Buried, forgotten, and sealed beneath a British coastal fort, the relic waits. When it is uncovered decades later, the war resumes, only this time it is personal.

movies.title: Glitch
movies.description_full: Four twisted tales where technology turns, strangers become monsters, and the darkness outside the door is the least of your problems.

movies.title: It Wants Nightmares
movies.description_full: A troubled woman named Adelaide confronts supernatural horrors and dark events while traversing the haunted American South.

movies.title: Class Clown
movies.description_full: At a quiet high school, Chester is the janitor that everyone trusts and is always watching out, always there when no one else is. But, a single humiliating secret caught on camera at a birthday party, turns him into a joke overnight. As whispers turn cruel and laughter turns violent, an accident silences Chester for good. Or so it seems. Because something wearing a familiar smile refuses to stay gone... the ones that laughed first, just might be the last to stop screaming.

movies.title: Clown Nightmare 2
movies.description_full: The treasure was supposed to make them rich. Instead, it unleashed a clown nightmare. Two clown investigators and their robot sidekick follow a trail of madness. Obsessed by long-lost pirate treasure hidden in a Kentucky town.

movies.title: Pickleballers
movies.description_full: Max and her best friends are forced to compete in a questionable underground internet pickleball competition in order to save her home from financial turmoil.

movies.title: Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro
movies.description_full: Two photographers, who are employed by a magazine editor to expose the scandalous activities of the rich, come across corruption by a builder and accidentally photograph a murder.

movies.title: Sleep Stalker
movies.description_full: An influencer couple buys an old home to remodel for their DIY social media channel, but when the husband's sleepwalking turns violent, they're forced to investigate his psychological past and the home's dark history.

movies.title: Twisted Hearts
movies.description_full: Three couples at a relationship retreat navigate intimacy issues, racial biases, and infidelity while an unexpected twist forces major decisions about self-worth and love.

movies.title: Bride of the Dead
movies.description_full: An Egyptologist in possession of a haunted Bride of the Dead amulet is the target of a tech billionaire who believes the ancient Egyptian mummy artifact holds forbidden magic that could awaken a deadly mummy curse and unlock eternal life.

movies.title: Wayward
movies.description_full: The story of the women who changed snowboarding by refusing to follow the status quo. spanning 4 decades of firsthand accounts from pioneering athletes who fought for visibility, opportunity, and respect in a male-dominated sport.

movies.title: Beyond Top Secret: The Era of Disclosure
movies.description_full: Dr. Steven Greer leads the charge toward ultimate disclosure. Bringing forward firsthand military whistle-blowers, the film exposes the decades-long institutional cover-up surrounding off-world technology and classified programs.

movies.title: Becoming Zendaya
movies.description_full: From Oakland dance classes to Emmy wins and box-office records, Zendaya's journey to Hollywood icon status through strategic choices, boundary-setting, and creative ambition—from Disney Channel star to producer and power player.

movies.title: Lizzie Borden: The Case Reopened
movies.description_full: In 1892 New England, a young woman constrained by Victorian society becomes the prime suspect in the brutal axe murders of her father and stepmother, sparking America's first celebrity murder trial.

movies.title: The Grimm Backward
movies.description_full: When a desperate late-night call lures a cocktail waitress and her boyfriend to a decaying desert town, she discovers Ox Bow is haunted by the Grimm-a soul-devouring creature that feeds in gruesome fashion-and must fight to survive a visceral, retro sci-fi nightmare built on blood, sacrifice, and betrayal.

movies.title: Tiresias
movies.description_full: After Jan recovers his vision through experimental back-alley surgery, he begins to uncover a reptilian conspiracy that may involve his doctor, Cleopatra.

movies.title: The Wandering Creature (and Other Tales)
movies.description_full: "The Wandering Creature" is an anthology of linked short tales-of-horror, from when an unmanned spacecraft returning from the asteroid Vesta breaks-up upon re-entry into the atmosphere and scatters sample containers across Phantom Lake.

movies.title: A Mother's Secret
movies.description_full: Strange occurrences haunt a new mother struggling with postpartum, when the discovery of a dead body hidden in the walls of her family's dream home leads down a path of dark secrets.

movies.title: Steal This Story, Please!
movies.description_full: Amy Goodman has reported some of the most consequential stories of our time. Steal This Story, Please. is a gripping portrait of a journalist whose unwavering commitment to truth-telling spans three decades of turbulent history.

movies.title: Capturing Bigfoot
movies.description_full: A decades-old film discovered after half a century contains footage that could rewrite our understanding of the legendary cryptid and force experts to reconsider long-held beliefs about its existence.

movies.title: Time Pirates
movies.description_full: Teen band SM6 is headlining their first gig, when the discovery of half treasure map sends them back in time to Mystic Island. To go back home, they'll have to find the missing half of the map and the hidden treasure.

movies.title: Remembrance
movies.description_full: Grace, escapes captivity, wakes with no memory. Detectives Isaac and Amanda investigate, uncovering her past and her kidnapping. Grace's hallucinations strain Isaac's connection with her, while Amanda questions her reliability.

movies.title: Pumpkin Patch
movies.description_full: When the West Hallow, one of the Four Guardians of Planet Ween, attacks Scare Force One, President Tepes crash-lands inside the dreaded prison colony District 13 carrying a mysterious hexagonal case she'll kill to reclaim. With the President of Halloween trapped and the planet on edge, Commander Ichabod Crane, Special Agent Katrina Van Tassel, and their cybernetic security officer Robo Bones of the Monster Intelligence Agency (MIA) enlist an unlikely ally-a pool-hall-roaming, bar-fighting vigilante with a pumpkin for a head and nothing left to lose. His mission: break into District 13, recover the President and the mysterious case, and somehow make it out alive before Halloween is lost.

movies.title: Killer Thong (TM)
movies.description_full: Two low-budget dancers, Cashier and Old-Timer, deliver a birthday gram for Alex, a closet lesbian. Traumatized by their crude performances, she has a surreal nightmare of her girlfriends being stalked and killed by Cashier's KILLER THONG.

movies.title: Star One
movies.description_full: A daring crew aboard the legendary vessel Star One challenge an oppressive regime in a sweeping tale of rebellion, discovery, and the fight for freedom across the stars.

movies.title: Man Chicken
movies.description_full: In this found footage comedy, two brothers go on an adventure to find the urban legend known as "Man Chicken." The trip takes a turn for the worst, as the truth begins to reveal itself, the deeper they travel into the forest.

movies.title: Echoes of Dread
movies.description_full: When a digital creator unearths a cursed film buried for over a century, she unknowingly unleashes a nightmare that spreads through her audience. As her followers fall under its sinister influence, she must race to stop an ancient evil before it turns the internet into its hunting ground.

movies.title: Confessions in Static
movies.description_full: Four friends reunite at a funeral and, later, find themselves under interrogation.

movies.title: Territories
movies.description_full: Five friends return home from a marriage in Canada to the United States. Not far from the border, two customs officers stop them to check their identity.

movies.title: Don't F with Mary Jane
movies.description_full: After discovering her boyfriend is cheating, an emotionally unstable Mary Jane goes on a violent spree to "test" whether the men from her past have changed-spiraling into a dark, comedic nightmare of love, revenge, and delusion.

movies.title: Swollen Creek
movies.description_full: The day Gina's life went down the toilet.

movies.title: Beliath
movies.description_full: While reporting on a brutal murder, a small-town TV crew uncovers a hidden cult whose secrets were never meant to be filmed.

movies.title: Crawlers
movies.description_full: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

movies.title: Perfect Soul
movies.description_full: Guided by mysterious entities who claim to be family, Nikki is shown the haunting secrets of her town, her parents and friends. Her faith is put to the test and sends her spiraling down a path of insanity, for which there may be no escape.

movies.title: The End of Nowhere
movies.description_full: A grieving woman wanders the beautiful and mysterious West Texas desert in her car searching for answers in the surreal and supernatural phenomenon known as "The Lights."

movies.title: Hanging by a Wire
movies.description_full: When a cable car malfunctions in the mountains, eight people including six students are trapped high above a valley. As time runs out before the final cable fails, rescue teams work against the clock to save the stranded passengers.

movies.title: Bikini Drive-In
movies.description_full: Kim Taylor inherits her grandfather's drive-in theatre. She must raise $25,000 over one weekend or the bank will take the property from her. She also has to deal with pesky capitalist J.B. Winston.

movies.title: Red Days 2: Cecilia
movies.description_full: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.

movies.title: Deadlocked: Dad of the Dead
movies.description_full: An accountant accompanies his daughter on a work errand that turns into a nightmarish zombie outbreak. Taking refuge in a restroom with strangers. He must overcome his fears to protect his child and survive.

movies.title: The Psychic: Files
movies.description_full: Two thrill-seeking streamers enter the home of a legendary psychic for clout, only to discover the spirits inside aren't just haunting the house - they're being puppeted by something far more sinister.

movies.title: Grindhouse Horrors
movies.description_full: A compilation of trailers from horror and exploitation films from the '60s through the '80s.

movies.title: The Bloodline of Bathory
movies.description_full: When five girls stay overnight in a remote house built on the ruins of Elizabeth Bathory's castle, their adventure turns into a nightmare. After one of them disappears, the group uncovers a hidden diary and an ancient woman still carrying Bathory's murderous legacy - rejuvenating herself through blood. As the castle-like house traps them in a maze they can't escape, the girls are hunted one by one. With history repeating itself, an unlikely final survivor must confront the descendant and end the bloodline before it claims her too.

movies.title: 83° Ski the North
movies.description_full: Seeking to find the most beautiful and remote places on planet earth the two adventurers Matthias "Hauni" Haunholder and Matthias Mayr were once again successful. Less than 800 kilometers away from the north pole you can find the Arctic Cordillera. It is the most northern mountain range of the world, located on Ellesmere Island. Getting there and skiing the most northern slopes in the world is Hauni's and Matthias' next major goal... They set themselves the goal to ski the most northern slopes of our planet. Simply getting there is an adventure. The north of Ellesmere Island isn't only one of the most remote places on earth but also one of the most cold. The island is home to polar bears and arctic wolves. On their journey up north the two adventurers don't only face major athletic challenges but also meet up with the Inuit who actively support their plans. Furthermore they have to accept that they won't be taking on the role of the alpha leader on this trip.

movies.title: 13 Souls
movies.description_full: After the death of her mother, fifteen-years-old Agne moves in with her father and older sister in a house near a cemetery, where eerie and uncanny things begin to happen.

movies.title: Tenchi Muyô! In Love
movies.description_full: Tenchi and co. find their existence unsettled by a time-travelling entity called Kain. Desiring revenge upon the Juraian emperor, Tenchi, Kain travels back in time to kill Tenchi's mother. Trying to preserve the timestream, Tenchi and friends follow him back. Unfortunately, Tenchi must also deal with the pain that seeing his mother causes him. Since she died in the future, seeing her alive in the past reopens his old wounds.

movies.title: Deformelody: An American Nightmare
movies.description_full: A disturbed 33 year old pop-culture-obsessed serial killer, terrorizes LA. Through his manifesto entries you ride shotgun on his descent into madness. The Killer's mission is to bring Americans together by killing everyone equally.

movies.title: The Sins Beneath
movies.description_full: A New York family moves to a quiet estate for a fresh start. When they arrive at their beautiful property they soon realize something is watching them. Their lives are about to be judged by the sins beneath.

movies.title: Marginalia
movies.description_full: Summoned to Karnstein Abbey to serve as a mourner at the funeral of their recently deceased abbess, Sister Trista discovers a dark secret involving demons, witchcraft and killer rabbits. But Sister Trista has a secret of her own.

movies.title: Hunting Party
movies.description_full: A group of Circuit Court Judges frustrated at the corrupt legal system are releasing criminals only to later kidnap and hunt them on a large estate.

movies.title: Thingy
movies.description_full: Frankie reluctantly attends a remote house party, hoping to avoid her ex. The gathering shifts when a guest arrives following a disturbing encounter, triggering the spread of a supernatural force transmitted through physical contact.

movies.title: Tiny Fugitives
movies.description_full: A reckless group of twelve-year-olds sets out on a mission to spend the rest of their lives at sleep-away camp. They'll just have to get past Bob - the camp's deranged, relentless, 50-year-old lifer counselor.

movies.title: The Musical
movies.description_full: When a frustrated playwright/middle school theatre teacher finds out his ex-girlfriend has started dating his nemesis, the school's principal, he decides to ruin the principal's chances of winning the Blue Ribbon of Academic Excellence.

movies.title: Wo de lao ban wei he na yang
movies.description_full: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression, a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

movies.title: Frankenstein: The Anatomy Lesson
movies.description_full: The making of Guillermo del Toro's Frankenstein.

movies.title: Blue Film
movies.description_full: Fetish camboy Aaron Eagle agrees to spend the night with an anonymous client, only to discover a disturbing tie to his past.

movies.title: By Any Means
movies.description_full: A notorious mafia hitman and a young Black FBI agent team up to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in 1966 Mississippi.

movies.title: Wasteland Cop
movies.description_full: In a Post Apocalyptic Wasteland, a hardened Marshal uncovers a mysterious device and sets out in search of answers, while something powerful watches from above.

movies.title: Queen of Hearts
movies.description_full: An Italian couple defy both their families and marry for love. Four children later, they are running a diner in England. Humorous, dramatic, sad -- everything a movie should be.

movies.title: Bad Apples
movies.description_full: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

movies.title: Love Scenes
movies.description_full: An acclaimed actress makes an erotically-charged movie with her director husband, during which she has an affair with her arrogant co-star and he clashes with his diva screenwriter.

movies.title: Turok: Son of Stone
movies.description_full: While defending his tribe from a bloodthirsty enemy tribe, a Native American warrior named Turok finds himself in a prehistoric dinosaur world along with his nephew, sister-in-law, and the sadistic leader of the other tribe.

movies.title: Forever Mine
movies.description_full: An affair between a cabana boy and the young wife of a sinister politician triggers a 16-year vendetta between the two men.

movies.title: John Crist: I Got Questions
movies.description_full: I GOT QUESTIONS, the debut comedy special from award winning standup comedian John Crist is a joyride of non-stop merriment. Crist's undeniable wit combined with his feel-good comedic sensibility will have you in tears.

movies.title: Dan Cummins: Don't Wake the Bear
movies.description_full: When the stand-up comic mixes his odd observational humor with serious subjects, like child rearing, or gun control, the results are hilarious.

movies.title: Night Terror
movies.description_full: A woman battles lifelong sleep paralysis while living in rural Illinois. As nightly episodes worsen her mental state, paranormal investigators suggest her condition may have supernatural origins.

movies.title: Baby Dolls Behind Bars
movies.description_full: Ditzy police cadet Sissy goes undercover in a security prison to get the goods on World Famous Jewel Thief, Maggie. Once inside she uncovers a devious plot headed up by the wicked Warden.

movies.title: The Ritual Room
movies.description_full: A wealthy couple, Amy and Alex Cummings have 'lost" their daughter in a tragic car accident several years ago, and Amy is in need of supervision whilst Alex is away on business. The trauma of the crash, the loss of their daughter and Amy's inability to become pregnant again because of her horrendous injuries, have all pushed them to a dangerous place. Lizzy arrives at their beautiful, rural family home to find all is not what it seems. Dark forces are summoned and Lizzy soon finds herself part of a devious plan. Death and murder ensue.

movies.title: Tropical Parasite
movies.description_full: A daring treasure hunter must survive the curse of an evil sea gypsy and lovespell of a haunting water nymph, while exploring the Andaman Sea.

movies.title: The Beast of Whisper Ridge
movies.description_full: Mark ignores a friends warning and local legends to go camping on Whisper ridge, where many strange things happen, and a Beast exists that people claim is just a myth. People have gone missing for a long time. But such things aren't real until you meet the beast of Whisper ridge. But no one has lived to tell the tale.

movies.title: Bigfoot Breeds
movies.description_full: Three sorority girls are dared to spend the weekend at a remote cabin, rumored to be in Bigfoot territory but no one realized how dangerous things are about to get because it's breeding season and this big hairy beast is in heat.

movies.title: The Leaching
movies.description_full: After waking up on her father's isolated forest property with amnesia, Vivian must use her limited memory to piece together the nightmarish truth, all the while being tormented by the undead, a giant leech monster, and her "father."

movies.title: Paranormal Hollywood Haunting
movies.description_full: British paranormal investigators explore a Hollywood mansion, uncovering true story of couple Daniel and Arthur, whose journey from homelessness to Hollywood history explores LGBTQ identity, resilience, and unexplained supernatural events.

movies.title: Pay to Die
movies.description_full: A group of filmmakers together making a horror movie are terrorized by a killer after hiring the wrong person for the job.

movies.title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
movies.description_full: A directionless young man battles self-doubt and low expectations. Through unexpected challenges, he discovers resilience and hope, proving self-belief can transform an ordinary person into an inspiring hero.

movies.title: Spidernado
movies.description_full: A rural British countryside is torn apart when a freak tornado unleashes a swarm of vicious, flesh eating spiders on the townsfolk.

movies.title: Its Presence Between Us
movies.description_full: A rom-com horror that provides a cautionary tale of what may happen if you don't allow yourself to be small in front of those who love you.

movies.title: Aliens Return
movies.description_full: A picturesque English manor transforms into a nightmare for bride-to-be Mya. While preparing for her dream wedding, she stumbles upon a mysterious black substance that unleashes horrifying events.

movies.title: What Happens in Miami
movies.description_full: Spring break becomes trouble in paradise for a group of best friends when one of their own goes missing and they are the prime suspects.

movies.title: Assault of the Party Nerds
movies.description_full: Ritchie Spencer (Richard Gabai) and his friends have a problem. They are the only four members of their fraternity, and they are all graduating. They must find a way to bring in more members before they leave, and dodge their way around the rival jock fraternity.

movies.title: Killing Oswald
movies.description_full: Using archival footage, interviews and dramatic reconstruction, "Killing Oswald" explores the mystery of how and why John F. Kennedy and Lee Harvey Oswald were assassinated in 1963.

movies.title: American Juggalo
movies.description_full: A look at the often mocked and misunderstood subculture of Juggalos, hardcore Insane Clown Posse fans, who meet once a year for 4 days at The Gathering of the Juggalos.

movies.title: Steve Howe: Live Legends
movies.description_full: An intimate portrait of one of the greatest guitarists in the history of rock. Join us on a journey into the world of Steve Howe as Steve explains his relationship with the guitar and how he helped shape the extraordinary sound of Yes, Asia, and GTR. Featuring rare performance footage, extensive interviews, and unique film of Steve at home and at work in the studio, this is an indispensable guide for lovers of great guitar playing and great rock music.

movies.title: Syd Barrett: Up Close and Personal
movies.description_full: The rise and fall of original Pink Floyd front man Syd Barrett is charted in this documentary, which tells the whole story from the formation of Pink Floyd, through Barrett's creative genius, his shocking slide into psychiatric illness and finally to his tragic and untimely death. Includes interviews with many who knew and worked with him.

movies.title: Gluten Is a Joke
movies.description_full: Through comedy, expert interviews, and absurd reenactments, Gluten is a Joke investigates how celiac disease became the punchline of a cultural joke and the real world consequences for millions who have no choice but to live gluten free.

movies.title: Social Media Killed the Movie Star
movies.description_full: A-list celebrities reveal how social media has transformed Hollywood fame in this star-studded documentary, exploring the pressures, perks and the new currency of celebrity: followers, likes, influence, exposure and the price of fame.

movies.title: Crude Awakenings
movies.description_full: At a ruthless PR firm, an ambitious publicist, Ava Rice, takes on a notorious energy company at the promise of a promotion. She must decide whether to sacrifice her moral compass and surrender her health in favor of financial success.

movies.title: Higher Calling
movies.description_full: Where do we go when we die? After losing his brother, a young man sets off on a motorcycle through the Himalayas, seeking a cure for his broken heart but finding something far more unexpected.

movies.title: In the Company of Wolves: An American Journey
movies.description_full: Academy-Award winner Jeff Bridges narrates the stunning journey of wolves and other animals through American history, reflecting a deeper story of who we are as a nation.

movies.title: Vicious Murder
movies.description_full: With his crypto empire on the brink, a businessman conspires to murder his wife and steal her fortune but uncovers a web of deception in the process.

movies.title: Africa
movies.description_full: A troubled fashion model must struggle to survive after a car accident leaves her stranded in the African bush.

movies.title: Haunted Heist
movies.description_full: Four estranged friends reunite at a house, where one plans to find a valuable antique by robbing it. However, the haunted house's ghosts force them to overcome differences to survive.

movies.title: The Odyssey: The Real Story
movies.description_full: After Troy's fall, Odysseus embarks on a treacherous journey home, battling mythical creatures and divine forces for ten years. As he struggles to survive gods, monsters, and temptation, his family fights to endure his absence.

movies.title: Affinity
movies.description_full: A man falls in love with both a man and a woman at the same time. What will happen when they find him out?

movies.title: 49 Miles More
movies.description_full: While driving to an annual reunion with their university friends, Max, an unsuccessful insurance salesman, and his fun loving buddy, Doug break down. With 50 miles to go, their only option is to brave the wilderness on foot.

movies.title: Escape from Area 51: The Hidden Scientific Evolution
movies.description_full: A veteran pilot and intelligence insider breaks his silence about classified experiments conducted at S-4, a covert installation hidden beneath Area 51.

movies.title: Sex and the Friend Group
movies.description_full: A shocking confession turns a close friend group upside down, forcing them to confront messy relationships, blurred boundaries, and the chaos that comes when sex, sexuality and friendship collide

movies.title: Winterland
movies.description_full: Winterland is Teton Gravity Research's 2019 celebration of ski and snowboard culture, exploring the fruits of a productive winter season in new zones all over the world.

movies.title: Now Days
movies.description_full: Surfing's next era belongs to six young women. In Red Bull's new film "Now Days," the Super Six drive each other to new heights in powerful, unforgiving waves worldwide.

movies.title: This Mountain Life
movies.description_full: Few venture into true mountain wilderness. A riveting portrait of human passion set high in the peaks of British Columbia, Canada.

movies.title: Contamination .7
movies.description_full: People from a small town are attacked by evil radioactive tree roots growing in the forest.

movies.title: Tribulation
movies.description_full: Tom Canboro is a police detective with a Christian sister, Eileen; a brother, Calvin; a wife, Susan; and an eccentric brother-in-law, Jason. One night, Jason seemingly goes insane and tries to kill Eileen, calling her a "hater". Tom realizes this may be a conspiracy going as far as devil worship, but as he speeds in his car to get help, he suddenly loses control and crashes. Waking up in a strange hospital, he finds that years have passed and people all over the world are wearing the mark of 666 on their right hands, and all those who don't are being killed off. Franco Macalousso, the believer in world peace of whom Jason was fond of, now controls the world and is trying to unite it as it was at the Tower of Babel. Meanwhile, the "Haters," or Christians, are hiding out and airing TBN tapes on the air for people to realize that the Messiah is really the Antichrist, but their leader, Helen Hannah, is arrested.

movies.title: The Militia
movies.description_full: Daniel Pierce dreams of joining the local Militia alongside his father once he turns eighteen, but when his Dad becomes the target of the local Sheriff, Daniel and his friends form their own militia in a troubled effort to save him.

movies.title: Letting Go of Jack
movies.description_full: When Brandon's faulty Ford Bronco dies in the middle of his escape to Colorado, he's forced to pick up Amber, an outspoken hitchhiker running from her small town.

movies.title: Mermaid Beach
movies.description_full: When Lily and her family move to a new town by the sea, she finds it hard to settle in, but then a magical discovery on the beach changes her life forever as she finds the courage to protect what matters most.

movies.title: Lego Friends: Heartlake the Musical
movies.description_full: The story line follows a girl who constructs a world out of LEGO bricks, only to be magically transported to Heartlake City, a place brimming with fun, friendship, and adventure

movies.title: Jitters
movies.description_full: Detective Collymore, a single divorced father, stumbles upon a mysterious case involving the death of Tiffany, initially deemed natural. Digging deeper, he discovers the horrors of Jitters,

movies.title: The Disciple
movies.description_full: A driven outsider penetrates Wu-Tang Clan's inner circle, channeling his ambition and creativity into an album that's about to spark worldwide controversy.

movies.title: Seriously Single Too
movies.description_full: Best friends Dineo and Noni plan to take on the party scene together, but things change when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously proposes.

movies.title: Katseye: Wild Hearts
movies.description_full: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

movies.title: Norm: The Tale of Norm MacDonald
movies.description_full: Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald uses archival footage, photos, and home videos to chronicle the SNL legend's career—from "Weekend Update" anchor to master of absurd, deadpan comedy whose influence endures.

movies.title: There's A Man Over There
movies.description_full: "There's a Man Over There" follows a group of friends who head out to Joshua Tree for a bachelor party, filming their weekend of booze and drug-filled partying. Unbeknownst to them something or someone is stalking them the entire time.

movies.title: Old Wounds
movies.description_full: An aspiring filmmaker documents a road trip with his girlfriend but discovers he's not the only one filming them.

movies.title: My Only Friend's a Corpse
movies.description_full: A punk kid run-away stumbles upon an undead corpse, rotting behind a dumpster. Convinced that the only way to save humanity is by killing god, the duo road-trip through a world of monsters, demons, angels, and the horrors of the Midwest.

movies.title: The Observance
movies.description_full: After 5 years in a coma, Madison Neubauer wakes to find her home and family in the grip of 'The Observance' - a religious cult who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets.

movies.title: Clean Hands
movies.description_full: The inspirational true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

movies.title: Tenzing
movies.description_full: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

movies.title: Masterplan
movies.description_full: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

movies.title: The Reality Experiment
movies.description_full: Eight strangers gather for an unknown experiment at the University for a quick payday. However, things rapidly get out of control as reality itself begins to turn on them.

movies.title: Crown or Class
movies.description_full: Crown or Class follows two young women whose natural hair journeys spark deeper conversations about beauty, identity, and the quiet systems shaping self-worth across Africa and its diaspora.

movies.title: Devour
movies.description_full: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

movies.title: Hallowarrior
movies.description_full: Desperate for companionship on a post apocalyptic Halloween night, the last girl on Earth gets more than she bargained for, when something far more sinister arrives on her doorstep.

movies.title: Tales from the Crescent
movies.description_full: Tales From The Crescent is a paranormal and true crime documentary about the legendary Crescent Hotel in Eureka Springs, AR. This captivating film tells the hotel's story and eerie history that have earned it the title: "the most haunted hotel in America". Featuring facts and stories about the hotel's most infamous owner, Dr. Norman Baker, the millionaire inventor and radio personality, who claimed to have discovered a cure for cancer. Tales From The Crescent weaves factual evidence with the mystery of first hand experiences told by those who have lived them.

movies.title: The Unforgiving
movies.description_full: Two survivors, who appear unwilling to answer questions, are the only links authorities have to a spate of attacks that have hit rural South Africa.

movies.title: McConadilla
movies.description_full: When perpetual man-child Henry Simms experiences a series of traumatic events, his wise-crackin' armadillo puppet, McConadilla, springs to life full of bad ideas to help Henry regain control of his world.

movies.title: Invite the Devil to Come and Play
movies.description_full: Oliver is an experimental musician struggling for recognition between his duties at home and at work. Spending more and more time on his strange music, he seems to have discovered an unexpected listener, one who may have a devilish motive.

movies.title: Secrets in the Sisterhood
movies.description_full: When a sorority president is murdered before rush week, her two Littles- Brianna and Chrissy- compete in an election to become her successor, but find themselves counting more than just votes as bodies pile up around them.

movies.title: This Above All: The Theatrical Life of Antoni Cimolino
movies.description_full: After 40 years, the Artistic Director of North America's largest theatre company prepares for his final season.

movies.title: Wingman
movies.description_full: A confident relationship expert and a rising dating app CEO reunite for a high-stakes matchmaking bet. As ambition, tech money, and power couple dreams collide, a hidden college scandal threatens to destroy their second chance at love.

movies.title: Dracula Eternal
movies.description_full: Dracula Eternal: A woman's idyllic summer is shattered when her best friend falls ill, her fiance vanishes, and she's drawn into a terrifying battle against an ancient evil in this modern re-imagining of Bram Stoker's Dracula.

movies.title: What We Dreamed of Then
movies.description_full: A passionate swim coach and dedicated father navigates the turbulent reality of invisible homelessness when he is forced to live out of his van.

movies.title: Sleepwalker
movies.description_full: Detective Parker Sullivan must investigate a string of murders occurring outside of his New York apartment. With the help of his superior, Sgt. Landon Andrews, he discovers that the killer is not who they seem.
Follows people living in a Sydney apartment complex looking for meaning in their lives.

movies.title: U.V.F: Underground Video Films
movies.description_full: Presented as a forbidden TV broadcast, this horror anthology revives unsettling short films from the world.

movies.title: The People I've Slept With
movies.description_full: A promiscuous woman tries to find out who got her pregnant so she can get married and live a normal life.

movies.title: Strange Events Sim
movies.description_full: In the dark and desolate landscape of a post-apocalyptic world, humanity clings to existence amidst the ruins of civilization.

movies.title: Deathgasm 2: Goremageddon
movies.description_full: When Brodie, a washed-up metalhead, resurrects his dead bandmates for a battle-of-the-bands, the result unleashes riffs, gore, and apocalyptic carnage only DEATHGASM can deliver.

movies.title: Psychopomp
movies.description_full: Amid a super virus that ravages humanity, a microbiologist leads his peers through a rogue planned exposure to test potential treatments. But as he becomes increasingly isolated, the line between what's real and what's not begins to blur.

movies.title: Stay Safe
movies.description_full: Stationed on the front lines of a Pandemic Hotzone, an Army Surgeon attempts to uncover the truth behind a subliminal message she received from a patient while dealing with the unexpected arrival of an illegal immigrant into her home.

movies.title: Adored
movies.description_full: Dani Monroe, an A-list actress, escapes to a remote Virgin Islands villa to recover from a devastating personal tragedy. Her search for peace quickly descends into a terror when she realizes she is being relentlessly stalked. When her trusted assistant arrives to help her regain control, the two women find themselves trapped in a paradise turned nightmare where they're forced to fight for survival.

movies.title: Stream of Terror
movies.description_full: When her picture-perfect life is shattered by a series of live streamed murders, Tiffany must confront a masked killer targeting her inner circle-before she becomes the last to go live.

movies.title: Tie Die
movies.description_full: Park Ranger Lloyd Kaufman teams up with Sheriff Joe Bob Briggs to stop what appears to be a killer bear from murdering more campers in the woods. After the park shuts down, a group of hippies must relocate to find their next camping spot.

movies.title: Blood Magick
movies.description_full: A witch with a foul mouth and a hangover is the only hope for a group of strangers when their town is invaded by the forces of Hell.

movies.title: We the Wine People
movies.description_full: WE THE WINE PEOPLE is a feature documentary about Virginia wine and the people turning a complex region into one of America's most compelling wine stories.

movies.title: Bunker Heights
movies.description_full: A savage collision of crime, comedy, and creature horror unfolds when corruption, violence, and something monstrous emerging beneath the city streets plunge Bunker Heights into chaos.

movies.title: Creature of the Pines
movies.description_full: A documentary investigation into Pine Hollow disappearances reveals a presence lurking deep within the New Jersey Pine Barrens.

movies.title: 100 Beds
movies.description_full: Contributors were asked the question, 'what is the worse bed you have ever encountered?' Their answers were wide and varied. A collection of self recorded anecdotes, exploring the world of bad beds.

movies.title: North Beach
movies.description_full: News of a slacker's infidelity spreads like wildfire throughout a tight knit San Francisco neighborhood, leading the man to retrace his steps and win back his girlfriend.

movies.title: Dementium
movies.description_full: Wyatt retreats to a remote cabin to uncover the truth about his mother's death. Using DMT to confront his deceased father, he's plunged into a nightmarish trip where his ex and a sinister witch battle for control of his fate.

movies.title: Nurse: Empathy Heals
movies.description_full: While people may think they know what nurses do, this documentary reveals the emotional challenges nurses face on a daily basis when caring for patients. These are nurses' stories about compassion and empathy, the grief that doesn't disappear, and the catharsis that comes from being heard. Through these personal stories, revealing the moments of doubt, faith, grief, joy, and fierce love that shape every act of care, the film celebrates nurses as the heroes they truly are.

movies.title: Surrender to It
