movies.description_full: A female empowerment grind house comedy action thriller. Jackie and her band of female vigilante assassins hatch a plan to kill six members of the evil male dominated court. With deadly and hilarious consequences

movies.title: Nightfall: A Paranormal Investigation
movies.description_full: The year is 1988. Paranormal investigators Mick Sutherland and Archie Charlesworth have built their careers on confronting the unexplained across Northern Europe. But when a desperate call draws them to the isolated home of Elizabeth Blair, they encounter a presence unlike anything they've faced before. Over seven days, this force begins to unravel their sanity, twisting their perception of reality itself and threatening to destroy their bond. This is no ordinary haunting. This is Case 13.

movies.title: Locker
movies.description_full: On a dive to the wreck of the Titanic, the crew of the Orion submersible become trapped on the ocean floor. Marcus Graves, his son David, social media influencer Jackson, and Titanic enthusiast Alejo embark on the perilous journey.

movies.title: Working in the Dark
movies.description_full: Kim tries to get a modeling contract to start her career. A death changes everything and forces Kim to try unconditional methods in dark places to get on a magazine cover.

movies.title: Why Women Trip
movies.description_full: Wearing her heart on her sleeve, Zori Johnson is consistently hurt in relationships. However, a new love interest entices her to open up her heart again but it is it the right move?

movies.title: Harbinger
movies.description_full: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

movies.title: When It Rains
movies.description_full: While Todd is at Graduate school to better his family, his wife Janice is at home taking care of her sick mother. The long distance marriage takes a toll on them. When Todd ends up encountering a woman named Sharon at a bar, sparks fly.

movies.title: Ghost Light
movies.description_full: Actress Marion Neal finds herself mired in a lawsuit over the rights to her playhouse. As strange occurrences begin to take place, the hidden truth emerges regarding an intricate web of interwoven conspiracies and villainous agendas.

movies.title: A Traveller Family
movies.description_full: 'A Traveller Family' explores the lives of four generations of the Collins family, from Big James Collins, one of the last Traveller tinsmiths in Ireland, to his great-grandniece and great-grandnephew, Catherine and Dan, aged 14 and 16, from actor and activist, Michael and Catherine Collins to Johnny Collins, 20, the first in his extended family to enter third-level education. Through one family's story, the film reflects on changing times, Traveller identity, and the powerful role creativity plays across generations.

movies.title: Castro's Spies
movies.description_full: Castro's Spies tells the thrilling story of an elite group of Cuban intelligence agents sent undercover to the US in the 1990s.

movies.title: B. Monkey
movies.description_full: A young woman attempts to end her criminal career. But she needs love to make it.

movies.title: Chasing Home
movies.description_full: A 30-year-old British-Mexican comic creator asks her parents for money toward her first apartment, but they can't help because her 51-year-old mother is expecting a baby.

movies.title: In the Opinion of the Censor
movies.description_full: Former Censor John Kelleher reveals how the decisions of the Irish Film Censor have mirrored the political, social and cultural evolution of Ireland itself.

movies.title: The Singe
movies.description_full: Fred spots ex-NFL player Ryan Van Orten slipping something into a woman's drink during a football viewing party at Ryan's inherited home, where Fred's wife dragged him to socialize with church friends.

movies.title: A Day in May
movies.description_full: In 2015 Charlie Bird recorded a series of interviews to capture what the marriage equality referendum meant to the LGBT community in Ireland. Now, Colin Murphy retraces his steps to find whether the referendum delivered on its promise.

movies.title: Racewalkers
movies.description_full: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural walking talent as they challenge the sport's top competitor.

movies.title: House Call
movies.description_full: When 16-year-old Mariam's little brother Vince falls ill on her watch, she calls their family doctor to make a house call. But when the doctor ends up dead, nothing prepares the children for the night of terror that follows. Adapted for the screen by Shannon Casto from the novella by Ty Schwamberger, directed by Michelle Henderson, and starring Texas horror great Parrish Randall, James McCreight, Bill DuBois, Joe Grisaffi, and introducing Rachel Paul and Vincent Galyean.

movies.title: Rennie
movies.description_full: At a Renaissance Festival, costumed performers find love and self-discovery amid uncomfortable period garments. In this world of make-believe, they reveal their authentic selves and forge true connections.

movies.title: National Theatre Live: All My Sons
movies.description_full: A manufacturer thrives financially during the war, but his success comes at a cost when his business associate takes the fall for wrongdoing and his boy disappears. With the war's end, he confronts the fallout from his decisions.

movies.title: Livestream from Hell
movies.description_full: During a live broadcast, Kevin Hart's show turns into a nightmare. Jokes give way to panic when real bodies appear. Under the eyes of the cameras, they must hide the bodies and survive the killer.

movies.title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
movies.description_full: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

movies.title: Alterity
movies.description_full: Set inside an abandoned mall, a ghost hunt gone wrong that unravels a government secret never meant to be uncovered.

movies.title: Gekijoban Mononoke Dai-San-Sho: Hebigami
movies.description_full: In the last chapter of the trilogy, a medicine salesman perceives a ghostly presence in the building's Ooku. Earthquakes herald a disaster: the most powerful of the *mononoke* appears in the form of a gigantic snake.

movies.title: The Nice Ones
movies.description_full: When Kate joins her boyfriend's friends at a remote countryside retreat, strange lights appear in the sky. As tensions rise, something unseen begins turning the group into eerily "nice" versions of themselves, hiding a darker truth.

movies.title: The Rage
movies.description_full: Based on the true story of the uprising that inspired the legend of Robin Hood, Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II in a fight for justice.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.description_full: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

movies.title: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
movies.description_full: Two decades after "The Swan" shocked audiences, the women who underwent extreme makeovers and the show's creators reunite to examine the reality series that transformed their lives and sparked debate about beauty standards in America.

movies.title: Seymour: An Introduction
movies.description_full: Meet Seymour Bernstein: a beloved pianist, teacher and true inspiration who shares eye-opening insights from an amazing life. Ethan Hawke helms this poignant guide to life.

movies.title: Day of the Evil Gun
movies.description_full: A woman and two children are kidnapped by Apaches. The husband of the captured woman enlists the help of his neighbor to find the Apaches that seized his family; not knowing his neighbor has unknown reasons of his own for helping him.

movies.title: Space Thing
movies.description_full: James dreams he's an alien infiltrating a spaceship to save his planet. The female captain and crew seduce him while conflicts arise. They land on an asteroid where everyone has sex, and James destroys the ship with poor special effects.

movies.title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
movies.description_full: London 1910: a passionate astronomer does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Her bold challenge to Edwardian patriarchy is set against the suffragette movement and advances in science and technology.

movies.title: The Jeffrey Dahmer Files
movies.description_full: An experimental documentary that uses archival footage, interviews, and fictionalized scenarios to tell the story of the people around Jeffrey Dahmer, during the summer of his arrest in 1991.

movies.title: Boy of Your Dreams 2
movies.description_full: Two college girls staying at a guesthouse encounter a dangerous mythical serial killer.

movies.title: Hishkenstien: After Dark
movies.description_full: Ramirez Hishkenstien, extraordinary method filmmaker, occultist, and erotic provocateur, has returned from the grave. He cannot return to hell until his earthbound purpose is fulfilled.

movies.title: Nutty Network
movies.description_full: A new TV Network launches that makes every bad decision imaginable. When the woman funding the station threatens to pull back her funding, the Network Producers do whatever it takes to get her backing back.

movies.title: Red Emanuelle
movies.description_full: A journalist finds herself caught in a bleak office, haunted by her thoughts and yearning to be free.

movies.title: The Hideous Sun Demon
movies.description_full: After exposure to radiation, an atomic research scientist finds himself changing into a murderous, lizard-like creature every time he is exposed to sunlight.

movies.title: Body of Nurses
movies.description_full: A doctor is led into a web of betrayal by his nurses on a fateful night shift at a mysterious hospital.

movies.title: Bad Girl Office
movies.description_full: A high-class jewel thief is coached by a unique educator, hired to reform her and set her straight. But when she uses her charm, the tables are turned, and the educator confronts his life choices.

movies.title: Angels of Tokyo Decadence
movies.description_full: A high-profile escort finds herself in possession of a mysterious orb that haunts her with a mysterious presence as she confronts the meaning of love.

movies.title: Babysitters Vs. Vamps
movies.description_full: Two young babysitters get caught up in a twisted plot involving a cult of vampires that may or may not be real.

movies.title: Runner
movies.description_full: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

movies.title: Desert Fiends 2
movies.description_full: A team of bounty hunters pursues the Desert Ghouls. At the same time, an influencer organizes an event in town, right where the demons plan to attack. Tension grows as both groups approach the same place.

movies.title: Hendrie
movies.description_full: This documentary charts the career of Phil Hendrie, a radio genius whose satirical brilliance reshaped comedy, as told by the very legends he inspired and narrated by Hendrie himself, revealing the man behind the microphone and the impact.

movies.title: Island of Lost Girls
movies.description_full: The story of three young girls trying to stick together as they get trapped in a sea cave filled with crashing waves, hundreds of sea lions, and monstrous elephant seals.

movies.title: Kill. Bury. Print.
movies.description_full: Spotlights the complex story behind local corruption and press intimidation in Southeast Oklahoma.

movies.title: Drones
movies.description_full: A man discovers a universal threat to his life, job and the planet.

movies.title: 500 Miles
movies.description_full: Two brothers run away from home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland's west coast.

movies.title: A Stage of Twilight
movies.description_full: Cora and Barry are a retired couple enjoying life in their seventies. One day, Barry has a severe coughing fit and is rushed to the hospital where he is diagnosed with a terminal heart disease. No longer able to hide his illness, or the unpleasant side effects, Barry makes the decision to rent a trailer home in the middle of the woods where he can die alone. His hope for a dignified death proves to be a dispiriting struggle for Cora, especially when Joey, a 17- year-old neighbor who acts as a surrogate son to the childless couple, enters the picture. As the days wind down to Barry's departure, she is driven to make a critical decision for them both.

movies.title: Echoes of Deception
movies.description_full: Brandi, a driven detective, risks everything to save her daughter as dark secrets, family betrayal, and a haunting past collide with a web of trauma.

movies.title: Wrong One
movies.description_full: After returning home to bury his murdered sister, Baashir becomes guardian of her daughter. As he hunts down those responsible, he must protect his niece from the same people now coming for her.

movies.title: The Paper Trap
movies.description_full: An ex-con with PTSD battles to expose a corrupt probation officer and psychologist exploiting parolees for profit.

movies.title: Worth More Than Gold
movies.description_full: A resilient woman trying to outrun a traumatic past crosses paths with a man fighting to redeem himself from a life of crime together they battle secrets, betrayal, and survival, discovering that true love is worth more than gold

movies.title: Drip Drop
movies.description_full: Things take a left turn when the wife of a wealthy self-made entrepreneur offers her best friend and her best friend's husband the opportunity of a life-time: a swinger's weekend for $200,000. Her friend accepts the offer, and chaos ensues soon thereafter, threatening the lives of all involved.

movies.title: Heart of a Woman
movies.description_full: Naomi, a devoted nurse, uncovers her husband's betrayal and transforms from an abused wife into a relentless force for revenge and justice.

movies.title: Faithful Intentions
movies.description_full: She thought she won a dream weekend. The intruders think she's someone else—and the lie keeping her alive could expose the affair that started it all.

movies.title: Angelina Ballerina: Dance Around the World
movies.description_full: Angelina and her friends explore dances from near and far as they boogie, bop, skip and hop around the world in these exciting adventures.

movies.title: Angelina Ballerina: Ballerina Princess
movies.description_full: Join Angelina Ballerina and her friends for enchanting adventures filled with princesses, princes, kings and queens. Dancing their way through Chipping Cheddar, Angelina encounters an evil witch, uncovers a Cinderella-like mystery, treats the king and queen to a regal performance, and brings an epic tale to life with her friends!

movies.title: Angelina Ballerina: On with the Show
movies.description_full: The stage is set with bright lights for big performances and fun! Come along as Angelina and the mouselings let their creativity shine and work together as they get on with the show!

movies.title: What a Day Before Christmas
movies.description_full: In What a Day Before Christmas, Nathan and Naomi are at odds about the direction of their marriage and Nathan's reluctance to get in the Christmas spirit. Naomi tasks Nathan with spending the holiday with her parents or else. Nathan agrees and embarks on an unforgettable trip with his cousin, Keith and a very peculiar Uber driver. Nathan must be at his in laws by Christmas Eve to avoid being in the dog house. Just when you think things can't any worse they do. Nathan and his crew seem to have the worst luck and with each passing hour, it doesn't appear to be in the cards for him to make it to his in laws on time.

movies.title: When Girls Ride
movies.description_full: When Samantha leaves the south to have a fresh start with her husband, she ends up meeting two biker girls named Raquel and Tammy. The three women grow close and decide to start their own Female bike club in a man dominated world. Things take a turn for the worse when they lose a biker girl from their group, Which causes them to respond violently in order to get justice for their friend.

movies.title: Vindictive
movies.description_full: Neeka will do anything to have what her best friend Dana has, even manipulating Dana's abusive husband, Tek, to join in on a deadly plot. Not everything go as planned, causing Tek's life upside down, and causing Neeka to make other plans.

movies.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
movies.description_full: Charting the Sheffield band's extraordinary journey from obscurity to cultural touchstone. Fusing footage from Pulp's biggest ever arena show with four decades of colourful, never-seen-before archival material.

movies.title: Triumph of the Heart
movies.description_full: Follows the triumph of St. Maximilian Kolbe and his companions.

movies.title: National Parks Exploration Series: Yellowstone
movies.description_full: On March 1, 1872 President Ulysses S. Grant signed into existence the world's first national park, Yellowstone National Park. The 2.2 million acres of wilderness is the only complete mid-latitude ecosystem left on the planet.

movies.title: Bloody Tennis
movies.description_full: Follows Sophie, who is admitted to an elite tennis academy hidden in the South of Europe, where she must contend with fierce competition and the school's increasingly sinister undercurrents.

movies.title: ChaO
movies.description_full: In a world where humans and merpeople exist, Princess Chao gets engaged to human engineer Stephen. What will become of their romance?

movies.title: Unabomber
movies.description_full: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

movies.title: The Deputy
movies.description_full: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

movies.title: Rush: Clockwork Angels Tour
movies.description_full: Rush's performance on their Clockwork Angels tour in Dallas. The set features songs off their latest studio album, deep cuts and classics.

movies.title: Don't Be Shy!
movies.description_full: Shyamili 'Shy' Das, a 20-year-old who believes she has life figured out, watches her carefully planned existence take an unexpected turn as everything starts spiraling beyond her control.

movies.title: Boorman and the Devil
movies.description_full: After directing Point Blank and Deliverance, John Boorman was offered to direct The Exorcist II. The film became a massive failure, nearly ending his career. Years later, cast and filmmakers discuss its ambition and artistic value.

movies.title: Learning to Fly
movies.description_full: Former competitive runner turned photographer Aisha McAdams documents elite ultra marathon athletes. After trauma forced her from the sport, she wonders if she can find her way back by entering an ultra-marathon herself.

movies.title: Neil Peart: No One's Disciple
movies.description_full: Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson team up with four revered drummers — Stewart Copeland, Danny Carey, Chad Smith, and Gavin Harrison — for an exhilarating and poignant tribute to late Rush legend Neil Peart.

movies.title: Tilt
movies.description_full: Nia is raised in a dysfunctional home by her promiscuous, barfly mother, and is on track to follow in her mom's footsteps. When introduced to a the game of pinball, Nia becomes an expert, and has a chance to step from her mother's shadow.

movies.title: Haunting of Winchester House
movies.description_full: A family moves in to look after the Winchester mansion for a few months, and soon find themselves terrorized by vengeful spirits. With the help of a paranormal investigator they'll unravel the mystery of the house.

movies.title: The Money Trap
movies.description_full: After half-a-million dollars disappears from a doctor' office safe, the cops assigned to the burglary case, Joe and Pete, set out to find the money and keep it for themselves.

movies.title: Antidiva: The Carole Pope Confessions
movies.description_full: Carole Pope shattered taboos with her raw, unapologetic music and defiant sexuality—AntiDiva is the story of a queer rock icon reclaiming her place in the spotlight.

movies.title: Warriors of Terra
movies.description_full: A headstrong animal-rights activist group plans a raid on a bio-tech company to stop the cruelty. They discover the true nature of the experiments that are really taking place. As they break into a biotech lab only to have their idealism crushed by the terrifying things they find inside. But when a genetically mutated human with a taste for human flesh gets released, they all struggle to survive!

movies.title: Tilt A Whirl
movies.description_full: A clown explores old fairgrounds. In deserted plains of Buffalo, New York, USA, a student studies the history of clown and personal amusement. For whom does she perform? Alone, she rides the tropes of camp - confronting the audience with her sense of style and speech.

movies.title: Through Sickness and Hell
movies.description_full: A police officer in an abusive marriage struggles to escape his violent wife while facing career risks and social stigma, challenging perceptions of male domestic abuse victims.

movies.title: The Lock In
movies.description_full: In the spring of 2010, a church lock in at First Baptist Church was organized by Pastor Chris. In the first hour of the lock in, one of the students, Justin, had an unusual "incident" and was "inconsolable." It was reported that he calmed down and kept to himself for the remainder of the event. Two days after the lock in, Justin reportedly broke down to his parents that he experienced something "evil" at the lock in. He also claimed he captured everything on tape.

movies.title: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story
movies.description_full: Follows the life and career of NFL wide receiver DeSean Jackson.

movies.title: Unfinished Business: Kingston High
movies.description_full: A local Sheriff, Keith James, finds himself on a desperate hunt for vengeance after the loss of his brother. While in the midst of solving the case the truth about his past is revealed making him and his daughter targets. Will vengeance win or will the sheriff's past get the best of him?

movies.title: Unwitting Deceit
movies.description_full: Tone and Omar, business associates in the world of black market diamond sales, quickly become enemies after a deceitful act. They are forced to set aside their differences in order to accomplish one common goal, get out of a critical situation and not to serve time. In the process something is uncovered way deeper than what meets the eye.

movies.title: Undercover Consequences
movies.description_full: Caught in-between two worlds, Pharaoh has to decide what's more important to him; taking the righteous path, or living the street life. Being loyal to the love of his life, or being loyal to the game.

movies.title: Unconditional
movies.description_full: Follows three families over about seven years as they struggle and cope with mental health issues.

movies.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
movies.description_full: Mistaken identity, unrequited love, and the supernatural are combined in Shakespeare's classic set in the woods of Greece on a moonlit night.

movies.title: Chat
movies.description_full: A family's fresh start unravels when their son discovers an AI powered tablet, unleashing a wave of terror tied not only to the supernatural but to dark secrets of greed and corruption that surround them.

movies.title: Zero Sum
movies.description_full: Ruth (Aimee-Ffion Edwards) wakes inside a featureless spaceship; she's no memory and is kept alive by a plastic tube connected to her lower back. Ruth removes the tube and as the searing pain subsides, her memory begins to return. She looks out of the window and sees hundreds of identical ships orbiting a green planet. Ruth remembers the pledge she made to begin a new life, light years away from the earth. Suddenly there's a noise from the other side of a dividing screen and Ruth realises that she's not alone.

movies.title: The Trust
movies.description_full: In this true life murder mystery, we know early on "whodunnit" (the butler, actually), but the surprising charm in the story stems from the fact that the lawyer is honest and morally upright. The story of William Marsh Rice and his legacy, Rice University, where much of the film was shot.

movies.title: Star Cash
movies.description_full: Following a personal search for meaning through astrology, filmmaker Hayley Garrigus discovers an unexpected intersection between astrology and financial markets. As she explores this world of financial astrology, where traders use planetary movements to predict market trends, a deeper truth emerges. Through interviews with astrologers, financial analysts, and those bridging both worlds, the film reveals how our obsession with controlling the future disconnects us from ancient wisdom about cycles and our place in the cosmos. In seeking certainty, have we lost something more profound about what it means to be part of the universe?

movies.title: Thou Shalt Kill
movies.description_full: A distraught ex-alcoholic mother who has nothing left to fear in life is confronted one night in her car by a crazed serial killer who can only kill those who fear him.

movies.title: I Live Here Now
movies.description_full: A woman finds herself trapped in a remote hotel where the violent echoes of her past come alive, blurring the lines between her darkest nightmares and the waking world.

movies.title: Milk & Serial
movies.description_full: A surprise birthday prank takes a turn for the worse when a popular social media duo must face the reality of the terrifying aftermath.

movies.title: BLKNWS: Terms & Conditions
movies.description_full: Adapted from the artist Kahlil Joseph's video exhibition that carried the same name.

movies.title: What She Doesn't Know
movies.description_full: The Film focuses on a group of high school seniors grappling with the reality of moving away to college. As if senior year couldn't be stressful enough, there is also a serial killer on the loose.

movies.title: Fwends
movies.description_full: Old friends Em and Jessie reconnect for a weekend. Their conversations flow naturally, covering light topics and deep emotions. They represent a generation of resilient young women navigating life's ups and downs with honesty and humor.

movies.title: Box of Rain
movies.description_full: A documentary film about a road trip, acceptance, and the healing power of music.

movies.title: The Love Hypothesis
movies.description_full: After an impulsive kiss, two scientists end up in a fake relationship, testing their theories about love and each other.

movies.title: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
movies.description_full: Unpacks fascinating story of Shelley "Siren" Beattie and her complex legacy entwined with beauty, mental illness and love.

movies.title: Legend of the White Dragon
movies.description_full: In the Aftermath, the city was left decimated. A past reminder of the great battle and fall of heroes. The heroes were blamed, stripped of their titles and hunted.

movies.title: Hitler's Cosmic Conspiracy: UFOs, Alien Artifacts and the Nazi War Machine
movies.description_full: Explore the mysterious legend of the Thule society and the mystical "Vril" energy that the Nazi's claimed aided them in their pursuit for world power.

movies.title: Mysterious Origins: The World's First Humans
movies.description_full: From the icy mountains of Spain to the scorching deserts of Australia, newly discovered ancient superhighways hold secrets to unlock the origins of humankind.

movies.title: The Idaho College Murders: Catching Kohberger
movies.description_full: New evidence reveals the disturbing profile of killer Bryan Kohberger, from body cam footage to digital forensics, exposing who he really was.

movies.title: Aliens Uncovered: The Golden Record
movies.description_full: In the late 1970s, the US government sent a message to our distant neighbors. Twenty years later, the response we received sparked the biggest UFO sighting in history.

movies.title: Dead $oul$
movies.description_full: In 1890 - the year of the U.S. census - chaos erupts when a man named Strindler arrives in a town in Arizona and requests money for providing the names of dead Mexican laborers.

movies.title: The Shitheads
movies.description_full: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

movies.title: One Last Shot
movies.description_full: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

movies.title: Before 'I Do'
movies.description_full: A game of Russian roulette. There are scandalous secrets and a cover up, and three people, bound to take them to the grave. Before 'I Do' draws you into the realm of passion and love, lust, lies, and friendship. A fast-paced, colorful drama with a splash of comedy and a myriad of surprises. At the heart, Caleb Abrams, a magnetic, Baltimore, MD, firefighter by day, artist by night, flamboyant and smooth, he could talk his way into a convent. As his "thirties" reluctantly loom to an end, he is on the brink of turning forty, and suddenly afraid of dying alone. Running in burning buildings gives Caleb an adrenaline rush out this world, but he can't handle the deaths that are seemingly just part of the job. But Caleb's sanctified father sees his dreams of becoming the next Van Gogh as less than practical, a strike to his confidence. He's at a crossroad. Just one year ago, the love of Caleb's life bailed on the eve of the wedding, opting to stroll the aisle with someone else. Finally, Caleb is picking up the pieces and moving forward with his life, but the scars are ever-present, bleeding into his present life and coloring every decision. In a twist, Caleb finds comfort. Best friend, She

movies.title: Super Troopers 3
movies.description_full: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

movies.title: Ice Cream Man
movies.description_full: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

movies.title: Left Behind
movies.description_full: The gripping new feature documentary Left Behind tells the story of five tenacious mothers determined to establish the first public school in New York City for children with dyslexia.

movies.title: Picture Bride
movies.description_full: Riyo marries a man more than twice her age. She is devastated and labors in the sugar cane field. At the end she is able to love her husband.

movies.title: Jacked
movies.description_full: In the Summer of 1987, after a perfect day at the lake, two small-town teenagers are stuck with a broken-down car and in a fight for their lives when they cross paths with a violent stalker.

movies.title: Alien Storm
movies.description_full: A businessman's grand Las Vegas party is halted by a mysterious fog, driving him and his guests into his secret bunker as a sinister presence threatens them.

movies.title: Spa Weekend
movies.description_full: Three friends go on a spa weekend that descends into chaos when their trainwreck friend joins, leading to hilarious consequences.

movies.title: Esau McGraw Used to Was
movies.description_full: In his first-ever stand-up comedy special, Esau McGraw brings the house down with his signature blend of quick wit, raw honesty, and unexpected twists. A Sacramento native who's earned national recognition on Def Comedy Jam and Martin Lawrence's 1st Amendment, Esau takes center stage with hilarious stories drawn from his childhood, relationships, and his personal walk of faith. With sharp timing and heartfelt moments, Used to Was is a comedy experience that's both outrageously funny and refreshingly real-proving why Esau is one of the most original voices in stand-up today.

movies.title: Israel Swings for Gold
movies.description_full: In 2021, Israel's baseball team competed in the Olympics for the first time. With no media allowed in Tokyo's Olympic Village, the players record their own experiences. Mostly newly minted Israelis, they log unexpected battles against anti-Semitism and anti-Zionism. Victory for Israel comes on the playing field, even if not on the podium. movies.title: Swimmers
